limitations: No latency, peak-memory, epoch-time or convergence claim is derived from MACs.
Profile cost matching applies only to on/on, r4, alpha4, SR and the frozen matrix-only scope.
RB/LB and feature-off rows are reported for accounting; they are not claimed compute-matched.
Representative point counts do not change native AirfRANS sampling or Car graph evaluation.
mac_definition: matrix multiply/linear MACs only; 1 MAC = 2 FLOPs
